        theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.TwoTerm.exists_presilting_sector_cover_of_mediants (k : Type u) [Field k] {R : Type u} [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] {V : Type u_1} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℝ V] (g : ProjectiveClass R →+ V) (n : ℕ) (E L : TwoTerm R) (hE : E.IsPresilting) (hL : L.IsPresilting) (hEL : shiftedHomFinrank k E L = 0) (hLE : shiftedHomFinrank k L E ≤ n) (hcovered : ∀ c ∈ sternBrocotMediants n E.projectiveClass L.projectiveClass, ∃ (Z : TwoTerm R), Z.IsPresilting ∧ Z.projectiveClass = c) :
        ∃ (s : List (TwoTerm R × TwoTerm R)), s.length ≤ 2 ^ n ∧ (∀ p ∈ s, (p.1.directSum p.2).IsPresilting) ∧ sectorBetween (g E.projectiveClass) (g L.projectiveClass) = {x : V | ∃ p ∈ s, x ∈ sectorBetween (g p.1.projectiveClass) (g p.2.projectiveClass)}

        Coverage of just the indicated mediants gives a subdivision into at most 2 ^ n compatible sectors when the reverse shifted Hom has dimension at most n.

        theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.TwoTerm.exists_presilting_sector_cover (k : Type u) [Field k] {R : Type u} [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] {V : Type u_1} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℝ V] (hR : IsEFinite R) (g : ProjectiveClass R →+ V) (E L : TwoTerm R) (hE : E.IsPresilting) (hL : L.IsPresilting) (hEL : shiftedHomFinrank k E L = 0) :
        ∃ (s : List (TwoTerm R × TwoTerm R)), s.length ≤ 2 ^ shiftedHomFinrank k L E ∧ (∀ p ∈ s, (p.1.directSum p.2).IsPresilting) ∧ sectorBetween (g E.projectiveClass) (g L.projectiveClass) = {x : V | ∃ p ∈ s, x ∈ sectorBetween (g p.1.projectiveClass) (g p.2.projectiveClass)}

        A sector with one vanishing shifted Hom admits a finite cover by sectors of compatible pairs. The reverse shifted Hom dimension bounds the depth.
